title: Harness environment, fixture keys, stub answer shapes and pass or fail gate are not specified for the X5 integration run
source: Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1 §R9; WP B-ITG-W4-07
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: RWB-ITG-E7005-ITG needs the SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and legal-action keys, the stub answer shapes for the six consumed contracts and the receiver fixture, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate; no source gives any of them.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-005 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 11295 to 11391) names no environment, fixture or gate; Arch v5 slides 15, 17, 25 and 41 to 44 and Temporal and Drools design slides 13, 24 and 26 name harness configuration nowhere; the WP line for RWB-ITG-E7005-ITG carries no value for it.
proposed: Agree the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and synthetic keys, the stub answer shapes, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave 4 entry check, and record them in the harness README; the fixture values stay data and no business value is hard-coded.

title: X6 integration harness environment, fixture layout, skip-trace answer shapes and evidence gate are not specified
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R7.3 and §R9; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E7-006 lines 11393-11474
description: The legacy story names the endpoints, data and four test cases for the X6 flow, and the thin sources name the feature and the rules, but no source states the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case and deviation key scheme, the NCB, EFS and agency answer shapes of the skip trace, the evidence format and its retention, or the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check. The story cannot be built, run or gated without these, so one placeholder is used in sections 3, 12.8, 13 and 15.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-006 (lines 11434-11470) gives PATCH /api/recovery/v1/deviations/{deviationId}, POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/deviations, the deviation, timer, partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row field IDs, and TC-E7-006-01 to TC-E7-006-04, with no environment, base host, fixture, answer shape, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 129 (FEAT-DVF-06) and line 239 (INT-30) name the system and the integration but no harness detail; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic case and deviation key scheme, the NCB, EFS and agency answer shapes, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate, and record them in the run report header so a stub pass is never read as an end-to-end pass.

title: X7 collateral event integration harness: environment, base hosts, fixture layout, synthetic keys, insurance-claim answer shape, evidence format and retention, and pass/fail gate are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-007, lines 11476-11571; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.16; FSD S3 Guarantees and guarantors v3 A2.8; Template and Rules v1 §R9
section: Sections 3, 12.8 and 13 (Preconditions, Contract fakes, Solution plan)
description: The legacy story names the endpoints, the states, the messages and the six test cases, but it states no harness environment, no base host per service, no fixture layout, no synthetic case, asset, collateral or claim keys, no shape for the S3 insurance-claim answer, no evidence format or retention for the run report, and no pass or fail gate. None of the higher sources in the §R7.3 fill order has them either, because they are harness configuration and not business values, so the story cannot state them and cannot complete its Done criterion without an agreed answer.
evidence: RWB-E7-007 lines 11476-11571: story, acceptance criteria, data, endpoints, screens, permission checks, validation and messages, test cases, guardrails; no environment, host, fixture, answer shape, evidence or gate. FSD S8 A2.16 and FSD S3 A2.8 describe the flow and the field catalog only. Template and Rules v1 §R9 requires the placeholder where no source has the value.
proposed: Agree at the wave entry check: the SIT base host per service, one fixture file per case, the synthetic case, asset, collateral and claim keys, the S3 claim answer shape with its claim id and status values, the run-report schema and retention, and the gate that decides pass, stub pass or fail; record them in the run fixture and remove the placeholder.

title: Wave 4 partner fee harness: environment, fixture, answer shapes, evidence and gate unspecified
source: _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-07.md; Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3 (RWB-E7-012); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slides 17, 41 to 44); Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 (slides 13, 25)
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source states the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner, instruction, invoice and case keys, the fee claim and schedule answer shape, the run evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate for RWB-ITG-E7012-ITG. The story builds the wave 4 integration harness and the evidence only and asserts the approval through the decision log and the invoice submission outcome, so these values are needed before its tests can pass.
evidence: RWB-E7-012 (lines 12474 to 12552) gives the story, AC1 and AC2, the data entities, two partner-portal operations and four test cases, and no environment, fixture, answer-shape, evidence or gate detail; the Ownership Map publishes no fee-approval operation and no invoice read; Arch v5 slides 41 to 44 and the S9 journey on Temporal and Drools design slide 25 name the owners and the workflow but no test environment.
area: Integration harness: environment, fixtures, contract answer shapes, evidence and gate
proposed: Agree the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout and synthetic keys, the fee claim and schedule answer shape, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave 4 entry check, and record them in the harness configuration rather than in the story.

title: Wave 4 integration harness for the partner review has no specified environment, fixture set or evidence gate
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-013 lines 12555-12633; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 143 (FEAT-PRM-10); Architecture v5 slide 17
section: §3 Preconditions; §12.8 Contract fakes; §13 Solution plan; §15 Screens and states
description: The legacy story names the six-point review, the two partner operations and the messages, but no source states the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner and instruction keys, the shape of the review evidence, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate for an integration harness of this feature.
evidence: The legacy section carries the data entities, the two endpoints, the screen names and the messages only; no test-environment, fixture, evidence or gate statement appears in the legacy story, the FSD row, the BRD or the routing rules.
proposed: Agree the environment, fixture layout, synthetic keys, evidence shape and retention, and the gate at the wave 4 entry check, and record them in the harness configuration rather than in code.
